title: Avoid thermometers, which spend ink on a tube and a bulb that carry no value.
rule: Leave thermometers, the tubes with a bulb used for fundraising goals, out of every Oath & Action piece. Draw the same count as a progress bar toward its goal, with the goal marked and the amount still to go printed.
use_when: No reader’s question calls for it. A reader who asks how close a total is to its goal gets the same answer from a progress bar with less ink.

use_instead.when: The value is a count toward a goal
The value sits against a target and ranges

text: A thermometer is a bar with a bulb at its foot, so the bulb and the tube’s rounded ends add ink with no value. A plain bar from zero shows the same share and leaves room to print the goal and the gap.
why.basis: Design judgment, from the chart system our founder and editor approved in November 2026

builders: No form: the kit draws no thermometer. The sketch, work/build/guide/specimens/s-14-92-sketch.html, draws a thermometer beside a progress bar of the same values; build the better choice with progress-bar.
sketch_alt: A thermometer fills an illustrative 70 percent of a goal inside a tube with a bulb, and a progress bar of the same values shows the share with the goal marked and less ink. The bulb holds no value.
